runs.empty: No runs saved yet. Every run from one hotkey press to the next ends up here – with boss times, best time and analysis.
runs.analysis_note: Active = share of combat time in which damage was dealt (gaps over 2 s don't count). Buff uptime only counts combat phases. Small differences from the game are possible.

party.empty: No party detected yet. As soon as you're in a party, all members show up here with level and Combat Power.
party.col.name: Name

timers.title: Timers
timers.schedules_hint: Fixed EU events, the times are always right. Just tick them on or off. Abyss bosses (Nahma, Executors, Kaira) are listed with the field bosses above.
timers.inactive_hint: Changes are saved immediately. Only schedules with "active" ticked appear in the overlay.
timers.unconfirmed_badge: * Times unconfirmed for EU – please adjust
timers.unconfirmed_note: * = template with times from Korea or the community, not confirmed for EU. Adjust under "Schedules".
timer_overlay.title: Timers
hub.launch_hint: Launches via Steam. If the meter is already running at login, it knows your character right away.
settings.launch_game_hint: Launches AION 2 via Steam when you open the meter (if it isn't running yet). That way the meter always recognizes your character from login.
timers.ignore_hint: Stop tracking this boss (e.g. dungeon bosses)
timers.boss_note: Other bosses (not in the field boss list): when one dies near you, it shows up here. Enter once how many minutes it takes to respawn – after that the timer starts by itself on every kill. Just ignore dungeon bosses.
timers.reminder_minutes: Remind me this many minutes before:
check.reset_note: Checkmarks clear automatically after the reset. 30 minutes before the reset, the meter reminds you of open items. Please double-check the reset times against the game once.
conn.no_data: No ping data yet – start AION 2 and log in.
conn.row.server_blocked: doesn't respond to ping – normal, many game servers block it
conn.verdict.AllesOk: All good – router, internet and game connection are stable.
conn.verdict.Heimnetz: The problem is in your home network (router/Wi-Fi). Tip: use a LAN cable instead of Wi-Fi, restart the router, pause large downloads or streams on the network.
conn.verdict.Anbieter: Your router is fine, but the connection to the internet fluctuates – that's on your internet provider. Tip: restart the router; if it persists, report it to your provider.
conn.verdict.Spielserver: Home network and internet are stable – the fluctuations happen on the way to the game server or on the server itself. There's nothing you can change on your end.
conn.verdict.KeineDaten: Can't check the connection – are you online?
conn.note: The monitor doesn't change anything about your connection. It shows where the problem is – your ping is measured directly from the game connection.
settings.hotkey_hint: Click the field and press the new key combination. It only works while AION 2 or the meter is in the foreground.
settings.hotkey_invalid: Please combine with CTRL, ALT or SHIFT – or use an F key.
settings.hotkey_taken: This combination is already used for the other function.
settings.screenshot_hint: Captures the screen with AION 2 and shows the image fullscreen on the other monitor. Click or ESC hides it. If the image stays black: choose "Borderless window" instead of fullscreen in the game.
shot.title: AetherDPS – Screenshot
shot.hint: Click or ESC to hide – take a new screenshot with your hotkey in-game
shot.no_second: No second screen found – screenshot not shown.
settings.party_only_hint: In a party you only see the party, solo only yourself and your summons – never nearby players.
run.title: Total since {0}

setup.title: One-time setup
setup.intro: For the meter to see damage, Windows needs the free add-on "Npcap". It only reads what comes in over the network – nothing in the game is changed.
setup.step1: Npcap is downloaded directly from the official site npcap.com and checked for authenticity.
setup.step2: Windows asks for administrator rights → "Yes". Then in the Npcap window: "I Agree" → "Install" → "Next" → "Finish". The right checkboxes are already set.
setup.step3: Done – the meter starts by itself.
setup.manual: Rather install it yourself? Open the official site
setup.about: Npcap comes from the Nmap project and is also used by Wireshark. Free for personal use.
setup.state.install: Installing – please click through the Npcap window (it may be behind this window).
setup.state.done: Npcap is installed. The meter is starting now.
setup.already: Npcap is already installed. All set.
setup.error.download: Download failed. Check your internet connection or install Npcap manually from the official site.
setup.error.signature: The downloaded file is not correctly signed and was NOT run. Please install Npcap manually from npcap.com.
setup.error.uac_declined: The administrator prompt was declined. Npcap can't be installed without admin rights.
setup.error.not_installed: The installation wasn't completed. Just try again.
settings.combat_hints_hint: Small pop-ups: the result of each Stagger phase (who contributed how much?), what killed you, and when food or scrolls run out.
hint.death_mechanic: No damage beforehand – probably an instant kill from a boss mechanic.
hint.death_mechanic_stagger: Instant kill from the boss mechanic: the Stagger phase before it failed ({0} of {1} points were missing).
settings.auto_track_hint: No hotkey needed: the meter stays visible as a slim bar and expands during boss fights. A run starts when you enter a dungeon (or at the first boss) and ends when you leave or after 5 minutes without combat. The hotkey just shows and hides the bar.
update.heading: Updates
update.auto_hint: Checks for a new version on every start and hourly after that, and verifies it. On start it's installed right away (the meter restarts briefly). Nothing about you is sent.
update.ready: Version {0} is downloaded and verified. It will be installed on the next start – or now with a restart.
update.up_to_date: You have the latest version (checked at {0}).
update.dev_build: Developer build – only the released AetherDPS.exe updates itself.
update.ready_toast: Version {0} will be installed on the next start. Or click "Restart" in the main window.
update.done: The meter is now running version {0}.
hub.character_unknown: Your character hasn't been recognized yet. It's recognized at login or after a teleport and remembered after that.
warning.title: STAGGER
settings.stagger_warning_hint: For bosses whose Stagger phase has a time limit, shows the bar and the estimated time left at the top center of the screen. Shielded enemies with a permanent bar only appear on the boss card. Clicks pass through.
runs.copied_text: Text copied – paste it in Discord with CTRL+V.
runs.copied_image: Image copied – paste it in Discord with CTRL+V.
timer.error_name: Enter a name and at least one time (e.g. 20:00, 23:00).
timer.error_interval: Interval as a number in hours, e.g. 3 – or leave empty.
report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Briefly describe what happened. The report goes straight to the developer – no account, no email.
report.placeholder: What happened? What were you doing?
report.attach_log: Attach log (helps a lot with troubleshooting)
report.privacy: Player names are replaced with "Player 1", "Player 2" … before sending. The version, language and Windows version are also included.
report.failed: Sending didn't work – are you online? Try again later or reach out on Discord.
report.need_text: Briefly write what happened, or attach the log.
presence_offer.title: Show your friends on Discord what you're playing?
presence_offer.text: If you like, your Discord profile shows e.g. "AION 2 · Boss fight: …" with elapsed time, just like other games. It only runs locally through your Discord, character names never appear. You can change it any time under Settings → Privacy.
consent.title: Help out with an anonymous usage count?
consent.text: AetherDPS is free and a hobby project. So I can see whether the meter is used at all, it can send a short signal once a day on start – no name, no server, no ID. Exactly this is sent:
crash.title: AetherDPS crashed last time
crash.text: Send the error report to the developer? It contains the error message and the log; player names are removed first.
whatsnew.title: New in version {0}
msg.title: Message from the developer
patch.title: Game update detected?
patch.text: The meter is receiving data but can no longer read it. This usually happens after a game patch. An updated version usually comes out quickly and installs itself. News is posted on Discord.
patch.toast: The meter can't read the game data right now – probably after a game patch. An update is on the way.
settings.language_hint: Applies to the interface and to skill, monster, dungeon and server names.
settings.usage_stats_hint: Once a day on start, without name, server or ID. That way the developer can see how many people use the meter.
settings.privacy_hint: Otherwise nothing leaves your PC: combat data, runs and recordings stay with you. Error reports are only sent when you click "Send" yourself.
settings.discord_presence_hint: Friends see e.g. “AION 2 · Dungeon: Draupnir” in Discord, with elapsed time and a download button. This only goes to the Discord app on your PC, not to us. Player and character names are never shown.
settings.discord_presence_waiting: Discord not found – retrying every 30 seconds.
presence.large_text: AetherDPS – free DPS meter for AION 2
fb.title: Field bosses
fb.hint: When you open the map in game, the server sends the field bosses of that map with their exact times – the meter remembers them. Bosses with ★ show up in the timer overlay and remind you before they respawn.
fb.open_map: No data yet: open the map (M) and the field boss list in game once.
fb.star_tip: Show in timer overlay and remind me
runs.discord_failed: Posting to Discord failed – check the webhook (Settings → Discord).
settings.webhook_hint: In Discord: Edit channel → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy URL. Every run then gets a "Post to Discord" button. Nothing is sent unless you click it, and only to this channel.
settings.webhook_invalid: That is not a Discord webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…).
settings.webhook_failed: That didn't work. Is the webhook still valid?
timers.overlay_hint: Reminders always come, even when the overlay is off. Every timer is its own pill: drag them freely, place them roughly side by side, stacked or as a block and right-click "Group" – the arrangement is kept. Right-click also to take out, remove or lock.
armory.no_server: Server unknown – log in or teleport once, then the meter knows it.
armory.not_found: {0} was not found at NCSOFT (or no connection).
armory.source: Public character data from NCSOFT (aion2.plaync.com). NCSOFT often only updates them after logging out.
profile.unknown_self: Your character isn't known yet. Enter name and server above – or log in once while the meter is running.
profile.need_input: Please enter a name and a server.
profile.enchant_tip: Average enchant across weapon and armor (without accessories)
profile.gear_hint: Click an item: stats, manastones and godstone.
party.popup_hint: When someone joins your party, their card appears at the right edge: combat power, item level, enchant, weapon. For this the meter looks up name and server at NCSOFT.

pets.summary: {0} of {1} pets in {2} at max level.
pets.levels_hint: The meter learns your pet levels once you log in while it is running.
pets.position_none: Your position appears once you fight on this map.
pets.map_hint: Wheel: zoom · drag: pan · double-click: fit
pets.source: Spawn points and maps from the game data (via SkeeveAN/Aion-DPS-Meter, MIT). Maps © NCSOFT.
timers.overlay_locked: Timer pills locked (clicks go to the game)
radar.title: Pet radar
radar.close_tip: Hide until the map is opened again
radar.no_position: Attack something or use a buff – then the meter knows where you are.
radar.enable_hint: A small window at the left edge with the spawn points of the pets you still need around your position, and the nearest ones with distance and direction. "Always" keeps it on screen so you can just walk there. The game only sends your position when you use skills. Movable; ✕ hides it until you open the map again or change maps.
radar.mode_map: While the game map is open
radar.row_tip: Click: all spawn points of this pet on the map (again: back to radar)
radar.no_self: The meter doesn't know your character yet – teleport once or log in again.
radar.map_tip: Mouse wheel: zoom (remembered) · Drag: look around, after 5 s the map jumps back to you · Double-click: back to you
profile.slot_note: NCSOFT shows skills (and possibly gear) from slot 1. If you play with another slot, this may differ.
profile.slot_note_tip: NCSOFT's public profile API has no slot selection. Most players use slot 1, in which case everything matches.
radar.short_hint: Minimap with the missing pets near you – appears with the game map or stays on permanently.
radar.collapse_tip: Collapse – only a small bar stays
profile.loading_text: Fetching public character data from NCSOFT. This usually takes a few seconds.
